title: E2E: attachment + group chat combined scenario
description:
What: End-to-end test combining attachments and group chat: 3-instance harness, member uploads attachment, sends group message with attachment, all members receive and can identify the attachment metadata.

Algorithm:
1. 3-instance harness (A, B, C).
2. A creates group chat {A, B, C}.
3. A uploads attachment (known 64-byte content).
4. A creates message in group chat with 1 attachment (blobId from upload).
5. Outbox delivers to B and C with attachment metadata in Peer/deliver.
6. B calls Message/get on group chat — verify attachments array has 1 item with correct blobId, filename, contentType, size, sha256.
7. C calls Message/get — same verification.
8. A downloads attachment — verify bytes match original 64-byte content (sha256 oracle).
9. Cross-tailnet variant: replace C's WhoIs stub with shared-in identity fixture, verify all steps still pass.

Oracle: sha256 of 64-byte known content hardcoded. chatId oracle: Python sha256 of sorted participant IDs joined by \x00.

Agent team: T writes combined E2E scenario (reuses harness from W4A and W4C); V runs full cargo test --workspace + clippy and verifies final test count >= all prior tests.
